The Lieutenant Room Safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at La Cascara Motel.

title: Office Safe - Brooks Boatworks
description:
Leonida map · Port Gellhorn · Safe

You can sneak straight into this room through an open window by going up the outdoor stairs on the northeast side of the building, then jumping up onto the roof. This Office Safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at Brooks Boatworks.

title: Warehouse Safe - Brooks Boatworks
description:
Leonida map · Port Gellhorn · Safe

title: Safe - Stash House
description:
Leonida map · Port Gellhorn · Safe

While facing the front of the house from Gellhorn Ave, enter through the side door on the right (south side) of the house straight into the kitchen. The safe is on your right just past the doorway by the fridge. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at the Stash House.

title: Locked Safe - Walker Farm
description:
Leonida map · Frogswater · Safe

There's an opening in the perimeter fence on the east side. Use the trailers by the fence there to jump up and over a gap in the fence missing the barbed wire. The Locked Safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at Walker Farm.

title: Safe - Weed Grow
description:
